summary: IceCure Medical Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing it regained compliance with the Nasdaq minimum bid price requirement of $1.00 per share. The Nasdaq staff confirmed compliance after the closing bid price remained at or above $1.00 for ten consecutive business days from June 4 to June 17, 2026. This is a routine regulatory notification regarding continued listing standards, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic change, or catalyst is involved. The filing serves solely to update the market on listing compliance and does not trigger any event-driven analysis.
